CSharpOnly.Reason: The fallback for an absent metric is presentation policy for an explicitly configured bar chart.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MissingText on the BarChart returned by New-ConsoleChart -Type Bar.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The matrix attention list needs an application-supplied health policy rather than inferring health from labels.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Assign IsHealthy in a native Matrix builder and pass the resulting widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The grid-to-list boundary belongs to an explicit cross-tab model, which automatic object tables do not construct.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MaxGridSize on Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The attention-list budget applies to an explicit matrix rather than the ordinary object table row limit.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MaxListRows on Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Selecting the attention view requires a supplied matrix and its health policy.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set NonHealthyOnly on Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A matrix legend summarizes supplied cross-tab observations; automatic object views have no matrix legend.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ShowLegend on Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The cross-tab title belongs to an explicitly constructed matrix with fixed axes.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Title on Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A shortened axis label must retain the identity of its full label and cannot be inferred from record projection.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ShortText on MatrixLabel when constructing the matrix axes.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Per-hop annotations belong to the caller-supplied path model and preserve their explicit order.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Add chips to PathHop before adding the chain to PathSet and showing the widget.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Per-hop status is supplied independently of the hop label and shared-path identity.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Status on PathHop before adding the chain to PathSet and showing the widget.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Shared-hop highlighting requires explicit path identities rather than an inferred object hierarchy.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set HighlightSharedHops on PathSet and pass the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The accepted chain length is a budget for an explicitly supplied path model.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MaxHops on PathSet before adding chains and passing the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The path-list display limit applies to explicit chains rather than automatic tree children.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MaxPaths on PathSet and pass the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The common-origin path view has its own title outside automatic object projection.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Title on PathSet and pass the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The reduced-tier marker is part of an explicit whole-row role, independent of per-column role rules.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set AsciiMarker on TableRowRole and supply that role to native Table.AddRow.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Whole-row emphasis follows the application-supplied row classification.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Bold on TableRowRole and supply that role to native Table.AddRow.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A whole-row marker belongs to an explicit row role rather than an inferred status column.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Marker on TableRowRole and supply that role to native Table.AddRow.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Whole-row muting follows the application-supplied row classification.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Muted on TableRowRole and supply that role to native Table.AddRow.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A whole-row semantic tone is independent of the ordinary column presentation policy.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Tone on TableRowRole and supply that role to native Table.AddRow.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A collapsed-node aggregate requires a typed application callback and does not enumerate descendants itself.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Assign CollapsedSummary in a native Tree builder and pass the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Repeated-node references depend on explicit graph identity rather than label equality.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set DetectRepeatedNodes on a native Tree with identified nodes and pass it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Value headers belong to explicitly configured tree value columns.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ShowValueHeaders on a native Tree with ValueColumns and pass it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Aligned tree values require an explicit keyed column schema rather than an inferred node label.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Configure native Tree.ValueColumns and TreeNode.Values, then pass the tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: An object aggregate for a collapsed node is application-specific and must not trigger another child traversal.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Supply CollapsedSummary through TreeHierarchyOptions when calling TreeHierarchy.Add; New-ConsoleTree retains its bounded object traversal.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Cross-branch deduplication needs an explicit identity policy; the ordinary PowerShell adapter keeps its wrapped-object identity rules.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Configure DetectRepeatedNodes and Identity through TreeHierarchyOptions passed to TreeHierarchy.Add.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A custom identity comparer belongs to a native application graph rather than PowerShell wrapped-object identity.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Supply IdentityComparer with Identity through TreeHierarchyOptions passed to TreeHierarchy.Add.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Knowing whether application-owned children are incomplete requires a pure application callback.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Supply IsIncomplete through TreeHierarchyOptions passed to TreeHierarchy.Add; use MaxItems, MaxNodes and Depth for ordinary PowerShell traversal budgets.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Stable graph identity is supplied independently of a node label or display value.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Identity when building native TreeNode instances and pass the tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A node reference records an explicit cycle or previously shown node rather than deriving it from text.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Reference on a native TreeNode with an identity-aware tree builder.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Reference wording belongs to the explicitly identified native node.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ReferenceSummary on a native TreeNode before showing the tree.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Keyed value cells require the explicit native tree column schema.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate TreeNode.Values to match Tree.ValueColumns and pass the tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The reduced-tier connector belongs to an explicitly supplied directional cross-tab.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set AsciiListDirection with ListDirection on a native Matrix, then pass it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The column-axis caption names the supplied matrix dimension rather than an inferred object property.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ColumnAxisCaption on a native Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Application-supplied legend words describe matrix statuses without changing their semantics.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate Matrix.LegendLabels by StatusKind before passing the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Literal legend markers belong to an explicit matrix and do not alter its cell statuses or counts.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate Matrix.LegendMarkers with ASCII-safe glyphs for all-tier output and pass the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A directional connector describes the relationship between explicitly supplied row and column identities.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ListDirection and its AsciiListDirection alternative on a native Matrix, then pass it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: An absent observation needs application wording distinct from a supplied healthy result.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MissingLegendLabel on a native Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The row-axis caption names the supplied matrix dimension rather than an inferred object property.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set RowAxisCaption on a native Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The self-cell legend describes explicitly identified diagonal relationships.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set SelfLegendLabel on a native Matrix before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Preserving both ends of an identity label is a native tree presentation choice.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set TruncateLabelsInMiddle on the Tree returned by New-ConsoleTree before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Preserving both ends of a detail or value note is independent of label truncation.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set TruncateNotesInMiddle on a native Tree with node details or value columns before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The ASCII node marker is supplied independently of status semantics and the full-tier marker.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set AsciiMarker on native TreeNode instances before passing their tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A Basic-tier node marker can differ from both full Unicode and ASCII markers.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set BasicMarker together with Marker and AsciiMarker on native TreeNode instances.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A literal node marker is application presentation rather than an inferred status.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Marker on native TreeNode instances and supply reduced-tier alternatives when needed.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The marker tone can express application meaning independently of the node status and label style.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MarkerTone to a ThemeToken on native TreeNode instances before passing their tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The value column caption describes the supplied chart measure.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ValueHeader on the BarChart returned by New-ConsoleChart -Type Bar.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A custom measure presenter belongs to the native chart composition.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Assign ValuePresenter on the BarChart returned by New-ConsoleChart -Type Bar.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Body blocks form an explicitly composed embedded view.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The footer is an optional widget in an explicitly composed embedded view.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ConsoleViewFrame.Footer and pass the frame to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The headline is an optional widget beneath an embedded view header.

CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate FactFlow.Parts and pass the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A fact tone is supplied by its native presentation builder.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set FactFlow.Role before passing the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The separator is explicit presentation for a native fact flow.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set FactFlow.Separator before passing the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Legend entries describe the application-supplied meanings of an explicit view.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate Legend.Entries and pass the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Extra legend words describe application-supplied matrix annotations.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate Matrix.AdditionalLegendEntries before passing the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A cell annotation describes the supplied matrix values.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Matrix.CellNote before passing the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Inline axes are an explicit matrix presentation choice.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Matrix.InlineAxes before passing the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Legend tones belong to the application-supplied matrix status meanings.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate Matrix.LegendRoles before passing the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The minimum matrix cell width is a native layout constraint.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Matrix.MinCellWidth before passing the matrix to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A compact column caption is supplied independently of the full matrix caption.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Matrix.ShortColumnAxisCaption with ColumnAxisCaption on a native Matrix.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A compact row caption is supplied independently of the full matrix caption.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Emphasis belongs to an explicitly supplied native path hop.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A hop tone expresses application-supplied relationship meaning.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set PathHop.Role on a hop in a PathSet before passing the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Compact connectors are an explicit native path layout choice.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set PathSet.CompactBranches before passing the widget to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The gauge maximum is supplied by the application alongside its score.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A fixed gauge width is an explicit native layout choice.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ScoreGauge.Width and pass the gauge to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A row marker tone is supplied independently of the row label and status.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MarkerTone on a native TableRowRole used by the table builder.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Compact guides are an explicit native hierarchy layout choice.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set CompactGuides on the Tree returned by New-ConsoleTree before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Value placement selects the layout of explicitly supplied tree value columns.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ValuePlacement on the Tree returned by New-ConsoleTree before passing it to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Separator-aware wrapping is a layout option on an explicit TextBlock; New-ConsoleText returns RichText and does not expose this option.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Construct a TextBlock, set WrapSeparator, and pass the widget to Show-Console or use it as a ConsoleViewFrame footer.

CSharpOnly.Reason: This per-node option includes a bare node in measurement of explicitly configured tree value columns.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set MeasureBareLabel on a bare TreeNode in an explicit tree with ValueColumns, then pass the tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A bare node omits the ordinary hierarchy decoration in an explicit tree.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set Bare on a native TreeNode before passing its tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Preserving both ends of one node label is a per-node layout choice.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set TruncateLabelInMiddle on a native TreeNode before passing its tree to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Header facts are supplied by an embedded view builder.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate ViewHeader.Facts and pass the header or its ConsoleViewFrame to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The header state is supplied by the application and can contain status markup.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ViewHeader.State and pass the header or its ConsoleViewFrame to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: An open-stream header describes collection rather than a final verdict.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ViewHeader.Streaming in a native streaming-header builder.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The embedded view title is literal application-supplied context.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ViewHeader.Title and pass the header or its ConsoleViewFrame to Show-Console.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Hidden column names are supplied by the view layout owner.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Populate ViewHint.Columns and use the hint as a native view footer.

CSharpOnly.Reason: The omitted-row count is supplied by the view collection owner.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Set ViewHint.MoreRows and use the hint as a native view footer.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Export rendering creates its own fixed profile from ColorDepth; the cmdlet deliberately keeps TrueColor rather than inheriting the terminal target depth.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame for its normal artifact profile; native exporters can set ExportOptions.ColorDepth explicitly.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A native artifact renderer can pin numeric/date culture independently of its host; the cmdlet leaves Culture null and uses the current culture.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Select the PowerShell current culture before rendering, or set ExportOptions.Culture in native export code.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native HTML/SVG callers may inject a custom dark ITheme; the cmdlet exposes only the ExportTheme preset selector and leaves the custom theme unset.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame -Theme Auto/Dark/Light/HighContrast; supply DarkTheme through native ExportOptions for custom palettes.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A native snapshot renderer can pin the session clock for spinners and header clocks; fresh widget exports keep the zero-time default.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Export a captured frame/session for its rendered state, or set ExportOptions.Elapsed in a deterministic native renderer.

CSharpOnly.Reason: HTML embedding hosts can request a styled fragment rather than a complete page; Export-ConsoleFrame produces its self-contained document contract.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Consume the full HTML from Export-ConsoleFrame -Format Html, or request Fragment in a native HTML exporter.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Export rendering uses the option's Full glyph tier independently of the ambient terminal target; the cmdlet keeps that artifact default.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame with full export glyphs, or configure ExportOptions.Glyphs in a native exporter.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native SVG consumers with limited text models can request one element per grapheme; ordinary SVG export keeps compact text and the graphics provider selects its required representation internally.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame -Format Svg/Png for the supported serializers; native SVG integration can set IndividualTextElements.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native dual-theme exports may inject a separate light ITheme; the cmdlet keeps the built-in light palette instead of an arbitrary theme object.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame -Theme Auto or Light; native ExportOptions.LightTheme supports a custom light palette.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native artifact hosts can alter the font-to-cell-height ratio; the cmdlet keeps the 1.2 geometry while exposing font size and cell dimensions.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame -FontSize/-Width/-Height; set LineHeight in native ExportOptions for custom cell metrics.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native page/image embedding can set its pixel margin; the cmdlet keeps the 12-pixel frame margin and lets raster presets choose their composition.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleFrame -Preset for the supported raster composition, or set ExportOptions.Padding in native embedding code.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native recording renders may pin numeric/date culture; PlaybackOptions leaves Culture null and uses the current culture.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Select the PowerShell current culture before exporting, or supply RecordingExportOptions.Culture from a native renderer.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native recording exporters can supply one custom ITheme; the cmdlet deliberately accepts the built-in Theme presets and leaves CustomTheme unset.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleRecording -Theme Dark/Light/HighContrast, or native RecordingExportOptions.CustomTheme for an injected palette.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native recording serializers can set natural-size typography; the cmdlet keeps the 14-pixel recording font. MaxFontSize is a raster fitting ceiling, not this setting.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleRecording -Preset/-MaxFontSize for raster fitting; configure FontSize in native recording export options for natural-size typography.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native recording rendering can choose a glyph tier; the cmdlet keeps Full glyphs rather than exposing another artifact-profile override.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use the standard Export-ConsoleRecording artifact profile, or set RecordingExportOptions.Glyphs in native export code.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native recording serializers can alter the cell-height multiplier; the cmdlet retains the shared 1.2 geometry.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use the supported recording dimensions and raster presets; native RecordingExportOptions.LineHeight controls custom cell metrics.

CSharpOnly.Reason: This Boolean controls SVG animation repetition. The cmdlet keeps SVG looping enabled; LoopCount controls the separate GIF/APNG graphics job and is not this property.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleRecording -LoopCount for raster animation; set RecordingExportOptions.Loop for native SVG repetition policy.

CSharpOnly.Reason: This is the export sampler's regular-frame cap of 900; Show-ConsoleReplay -MaxFrames governs the different in-terminal player job.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Export-ConsoleRecording -FramesPerSecond for export sampling frequency; native RecordingExportOptions.MaxFrames controls the export cap.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native recording page/image hosts can change the pixel margin; PlaybackOptions retains the 12-pixel export margin.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use recording raster presets for the supported layout, or set RecordingExportOptions.Padding in native artifact embedding.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native asciicast serialization can override the optional header timestamp; the cmdlet does not add an export-time timestamp override.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Keep the recording's source metadata through Export-ConsoleRecording, or set Timestamp when a native caller creates an asciicast header.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native selection hosts can attach metadata separate from Choice.Value. PowerShell selectors retain the chosen source object and return its value without a separate Tag projection.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Keep metadata on the original PowerShell choice object; native Choice.Tag remains available to a typed selection host.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A native app host can inject its full-screen live-session configuration; Show-ConsoleApp owns the session and maps input, capture, profile and theme through Interactive instead.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Use Show-ConsoleApp -InputSource/-Capture/-Profile/-Theme/-Mode; native ConsoleAppOptions.Live configures a custom session host.

CSharpOnly.Reason: A native full-screen form can run a MenuContext dashboard callback before leaving its screen. Read-ConsoleForm returns submitted answers and does not run another work callback inside that screen.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Read the form result, then invoke the requested PowerShell work or dashboard; native FormOptions.AfterSubmit retains in-screen composition.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native prompt hosts can inject a customized PromptLabels instance. PowerShell resolves the built-in catalogue from the active profile language rather than accepting a replacement label object.
CSharpOnly.Alternative: Select CONSOLEMONSTER_LANGUAGE or the UI culture; set each question's Title/Description for its own wording.

CSharpOnly.Reason: Native embeddings can inject line-oriented input/output devices. PSInteractive chooses the owning PowerShell host UI for Line/Accessible modes, including remoting and ISE.
